description: Tes Kemampuan Akademik (TKA): the assessment framework for SD/MI/sederajat and SMP/MTs/sederajat (Bahasa Indonesia: text types, text characteristics, reading aspects, competencies and subcompetencies; Matematika: elements, abilities, cognitive levels with thinking processes, content per element and sub-element with scope and notes), item types and forms, test subjects per level with the 20 SMA/SMK electives, the test schedule with minutes per test and session times (WIB/WITA/WIT), score ranges, result categories and the 'istimewa' thresholds, the 24 sample questions of 047 (stimuli, questions, options, statements, keys; 13 figures in contoh-soal/), and the 2026 category limits for SD/MI and SMP/MTs (secondary: press reports, with one conflicting report).
status: ready (frameworks for SD/MI and SMP/MTs only: SMA/SMK later, when a framework is published; category limits are secondary, from press reports)
source: Perka BSKAP 047/H/AN/2025 (2025-07-24), Lampiran parts II–III, and Kepmendikdasmen 56/2026 (2026-03-06), Lampiran BAB IV, VIII and X. Raw PDFs and SOURCE.txt in sources/kerangka-tka/
procedure: Transcribed as printed into tools/converters/kerangka-tka.py from the PDFs' text layer; python3 -I tools/converters/kerangka-tka.py sources/kerangka-tka data checks every sentence, list item and table cell against the PDF (letters and digits in the page text or in a pdfplumber table cell of 047 p. 7–25 and 56), checks that every table cell of the framework tables is covered, checks minutes and session times against 56 p. 47–48 (also read on the page images), then writes kerangka-tka.json. Sample questions (047 part IV) are in tools/converters/kerangka_tka_contoh_soal.py: text-layer units are checked against the raw and layout text of p. 25–46, formulas (TeX between $…$) and texts inside images were read on the page images, every key was recomputed (all match); figures are cut from 200-dpi page renders with pdftoppm and Pillow, so their bytes depend on those versions. Category limits are not in any regulation found (56/2026, Juknis 017/F/AN/2026): user decision 2026-11-27 stores the limits reported from the Pusmendik briefing of 2026-05-26 with confidence 'secondary' and keeps the conflicting Medcom report for Matematika SMP. Printing errors are kept and listed in errata (F-031). Version = date of the newest source (Kepmendikdasmen 56/2026). Third-party texts and images in the samples are used for education with credit to their owners (F-034); the converter refuses a stimulus without attribution.

format.kerangka-tka.json: source; item_types[{key,label,description}]; item_forms_intro; item_forms[{key,label,description}]; levels[{level,grades,subjects,electives?{choose,options (numbers in electives),note?},framework}]; levels_note; electives[{no,label}]; frameworks[{level,subject,pages,intro,muatan,kompetensi}] — Bahasa Indonesia: muatan{intro,text_types[],text_characteristics[]}, kompetensi{aspects[],competencies[{no,name,description,subcompetencies[]}]}; Matematika: muatan{intro,elements[],notes[]}, kompetensi{intro,abilities[],cognitive_intro,cognitive_levels[{level,name,name_en,processes[{name,description}]}],content_intro,content[{no,element,sub_element,competency,scope[],note?}]}; schedule[{levels,days[{day,label,tests[{name,minutes}],sessions[{session,wib,wita,wit}]}]}]; schedule_notes; scoring{ranges[{levels,min,max,decimals,istimewa_from}],categories,texts,note,limits{year,levels,confidence,categories[{category,min,max|max_exclusive}],istimewa_from,applies_to,sources[],notes[],conflicting_reports[]}}; sample_questions{source,attribution_rule,notes,stimuli[{id,level,subject,questions,lead,page,figures,title?,text[]|parts[{label,title,byline?,attribution,text[]}],text_from_image,source?,attribution{credit,owner?,url?,note?}}],questions[{level,subject,no,page,stimulus?,kompetensi,subkompetensi?|elemen,sub_elemen,level_kognitif,bentuk_soal (as printed),jenis_soal?,item_form (pg|pgk_mcma|pgk_kategori, as built),question[] (paragraphs; a table as {table}),figures?,options[{label|no,text|figure+text_from_image}] or responses+statements[],key,key_printed}],errata[]}. Math is TeX between $…$; figure paths are relative to the set folder; errata[{source,page,printed,reason}]. List items keep their printed punctuation.
